// 1. Функция поиска индекса машины по её ID в игре
stock FindCarID(vehicleid)
{
    for(new i = 0; i < sizeof(cInfo); i++)
    {
        if(cInfo[i][cCar] == vehicleid) return i;
    }
    return -1;
}

// 2. Функция применения ВСЕГО тюнинга (номера + тонировка)
stock ApplyVehicleTuning(idx)
{
    if(idx == -1 || !IsValidVehicle(cInfo[idx][cCar])) return 0;

    // --- Применение тонировки ---
    if(cInfo[idx][cToner_alpha] > 0)
    {
        new r, g, b;
        if(sscanf(cInfo[idx][cToner_rgb], "p<,>iii", r, g, b)) { r = 0; g = 0; b = 0; }

        // Используем глобальный сток для всех вокруг
        SetWindowTined(cInfo[idx][cCar], cInfo[idx][cToner_glass_id], r, g, b, cInfo[idx][cToner_alpha]);
    }
    return 1;
}

// 3. Исправленный сток для одного игрока (убрали ошибку 076)
stock SetWindowTinedForPlayer(p_id, v_id, glass, r, g, b, alpha)
{
    new BitStream:bsn = BS_New();
    BS_WriteValue(bsn, PR_UINT8, 215);
    BS_WriteValue(bsn, PR_UINT16, v_id);
    BS_WriteValue(bsn, PR_UINT8, glass);
    BS_WriteValue(bsn, PR_UINT8, r);
    BS_WriteValue(bsn, PR_UINT8, g);
    BS_WriteValue(bsn, PR_UINT8, b);
    BS_WriteValue(bsn, PR_UINT8, alpha);
    PR_SendPacket(bsn, p_id);
    BS_Delete(bsn);
    return 1;
}

public: TimerRed1(playerid)
{
    if(IsPlayerInRangeOfPoint(playerid, 100.0, 2493.7100, -2155.2800, 21.3300))
    {
        if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"poezd") == 1)
        {
            SetDynamicObjectMaterial(jdshlak[0], 3, 12085, "svetofor_rus", "red1", 0);
            SetDynamicObjectMaterial(jdshlak[0], 6, 12085, "svetofor_rus", "redon", 0);
            SetDynamicObjectMaterial(jdshlak[1], 3, 12085, "svetofor_rus", "red1", 0);
            SetDynamicObjectMaterial(jdshlak[1], 6, 12085, "svetofor_rus", "redon", 0);
            SetTimer("TimerRed2", 1500, false);
		}
    }
    else
    {
        if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"poezd") == 0)
        {
            MoveDynamicObject(door[9], 2504.5100, -2144.4700, 22.5000-0.004, 0.004, 0.0000, -70.0000, -90.0000);
            MoveDynamicObject(door[10], 2483.6300, -2165.5900, 22.6000-0.004, 0.004, 0.0000, -70.0000, 90.0000);
            SetDynamicObjectMaterial(jdshlak[0], 3, 12085, "svetofor_rus", "red1", 0);
            SetDynamicObjectMaterial(jdshlak[0], 6, 12085, "svetofor_rus", "red2", 0);
            SetDynamicObjectMaterial(jdshlak[1], 3, 12085, "svetofor_rus", "red1", 0);
            SetDynamicObjectMaterial(jdshlak[1], 6, 12085, "svetofor_rus", "red2", 0);
		}
    }
    return 1;
}

public OnGameModeExit()
{
    for(new i = 0; i < TOTALCARS; i++) // TOTALCARS — ваше макс. кол-во машин
    {
        if(cInfo[i][cID] != 0)
        {
            mysql_format(mysql_connect_ID, str_small, sizeof(str_small), "UPDATE `" #DB_CARS "` SET `gas` = '%f' WHERE `ID` = '%d'", cInfo[i][cGas], cInfo[i][cID]);
            mysql_tquery(mysql_connect_ID, str_small, "", "");
        }
    }
	//SMSDisconnect();

	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerRequestClass( playerid, classid )
{
	if( GetPVarInt( playerid, "gLogged" ) )
		return SpawnPlayer( playerid );

	ClearVar();

    InterpolateCameraPos(playerid, 222.586059, 753.151794, 25.200056, 196.429428, 829.282836, 24.412954, 80000);
    InterpolateCameraLookAt(playerid, 217.617187, 752.725891, 24.840990, 192.515380, 826.177673, 24.217691, 80000);
	SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerid,90.0000);

	GetPlayerName(playerid, pInfo[playerid][pName], MAX_PLAYER_NAME);

	mysql_format:str_small( "SELECT ID, Ban, Pass FROM `" #DB_ACCOUNTS "` WHERE `Name` = '%s' LIMIT 1", pInfo[playerid][pName]);
	mysql_tquery( mysql_connect_ID, str_small, "OnPlayerFind", "i", playerid );

	GetPlayerIp( playerid, pInfo[playerid][pIP], 17 );

	format:str_small("" #C_LIGHTBLUE "[CONNECT] %s[%d] - %s",pInfo[playerid][pName],playerid,pInfo[playerid][pIP]);
	SAMT(COLOR_WHITE, str_small, 3);
	str_small[0] = EOS;

	mysql_format:str_small( "SELECT `ip` FROM `bans` WHERE `ip` = '%s' LIMIT 1", pInfo[playerid][pIP] );
	mysql_tquery( mysql_connect_ID, str_small, "OnPlayerBannedIp","i", playerid );

	new buffers[40+1];
	new reason[64] = "Снят";
    GetPlayerClientID(playerid, buffers);
	mysql_format:str_small( "SELECT `GPCI` FROM `banpc` WHERE `GPCI` = '%s' LIMIT 1", buffers);
	mysql_tquery( mysql_connect_ID, str_small, "OnPlayerBannedPc","is", playerid,reason );
	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerClickMap(playerid, Float:fX, Float:fY, Float:fZ)
{
    if(pInfo[playerid][pAdmin]!=0)
    {
    	if(ClickMap[playerid]==true) SetPlayerPos(playerid, fX, fY, fZ);
    }
    return 1;
}

public OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    SetTimerEx("DelayedCefInit", 1000, false, "i", playerid);

    for(new i; i < 20; i++) SendClientMessage(playerid, -1, !" ");

    gTabVisible[playerid] = false;

	SetPlayerColor(playerid,0xFFFFFF00);

*/

public OnPlayerDisconnect(playerid, reason)
{
    if(reason == 0) format:str_least("вылет/краш");
	if(reason == 1) format:str_least("вышел");
	if(reason == 2) format:str_least("кик/бан");
    SendMes(playerid,COLOR_WHITE,"Вас отключили причина: %s",str_least);
    //for(new i; i < 20; i++) SendClientMessage(playerid, -1, !" ");
	//SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xF4A419FF, "Сервер закрыл соединение!");
    TextDrawDestroy(zapravkai[0][playerid]),TextDrawDestroy(zapravkai[1][playerid]);
    TextDrawDestroy(ftextdrawp[0][playerid]),TextDrawDestroy(ftextdrawp[1][playerid]);
    //PlayerTextDrawDestroy(playerid,pgruz1[playerid]), PlayerTextDrawDestroy(playerid,pgruz2[playerid]),PlayerTextDrawDestroy(playerid,pstr1[playerid]),PlayerTextDrawDestroy(playerid,pstr2[playerid]), PlayerTextDrawDestroy(playerid,Speedmetr2[playerid]), PlayerTextDrawDestroy(playerid,namenter[playerid]);
	//TextDrawDestroy(Speedmetr3[playerid]), TextDrawDestroy(Speedmetr4[playerid]);
	//TextDrawDestroy(Speedmetr10[playerid]), TextDrawDestroy(Speedmetr11[playerid]);
    TextDrawDestroy(texttruck[0][playerid]),TextDrawDestroy(texttruck[1][playerid]),TextDrawDestroy(texttruck[2][playerid]),TextDrawDestroy(texttruck[3][playerid]),TextDrawDestroy(texttruck[4][playerid]);
    for(new i; i != 11; i++) TextDrawDestroy(skintext[i][playerid]);
    AcceptGetHere[playerid] = 1;
	AcceptGoto[playerid] = 1;
	AcceptSpec[playerid] = 1;
	KillList[playerid] = false;
	SaveFullDostup(playerid);
	pShowSpeedo[playerid] = false;
    gTabVisible[playerid] = false;
	if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)!=-1)
	{
		new vehidres = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
		ResVeh[vehidres][Status] = true;
		ResVeh[vehidres][Timer] = SetTimerEx("RespawnVehicle", 1000*300, 0, "d", vehidres);
		//SetVehicleToRespawn(vehidres);
	}
	if(BusTimer[playerid] != INVALID_TIMER_ID) {
    KillTimer(BusTimer[playerid]);
    BusTimer[playerid] = INVALID_TIMER_ID;
    }
//====================[CALL ACTIVE]===========================
	acInfo[playerid][CallActive] = false;
	acInfo[playerid][CallStatus] = false;
	acInfo[playerid][CallAdminStatus] = false;
	acInfo[playerid][CallAdminReport] = -1;
//============================================================


    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"ccfon")==1) DeletePVar(playerid,"ccfon"), TextDrawHideForPlayer( playerid, ccfon );
	//if(GZ[playerid]!=false) GZ[playerid] = false;

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"antiq")==1)
	{
		new string[128];
		format(string,sizeof(string),"[ANTI-Q] Игрок %s вышел при запрете, выдал наказание! :)",pInfo[playerid][pName]);
		SAM(COLOR_RED,string);
		mysql_format:str_small("UPDATE `" #DB_ACCOUNTS "` SET `Arrest` = '%s' WHERE `ID` = '%d'",gettime() + 1800,pInfo[playerid][pID]),
		mysql_function_query(mysql_connect_ID, str_small, false, "", "");
	}


    format:str_small("" #C_LIGHTBLUE "[DISCONNECT] %s[%d] - %s (%s)",pInfo[playerid][pName],playerid,pInfo[playerid][pIP], str_least);
	SAMT(COLOR_WHITE, str_small, 3);
	str_small[0] = EOS;
	str_least[0] = EOS;

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"gLogged")!=1) return 1;
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"truck")==1) konec(playerid);
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"buycar") >= 1) DestroyVehicleNew(playersellcar[playerid]), playersellcar[playerid]=EOS;
    if(adcar[playerid]!=0) DestroyVehicleNew(adcar[playerid]), adcar[playerid]=0;
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"pme")==1)
    {
		DestroyDynamic3DPlayer( pInfo[playerid][pDesc], playerid );
	}

    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"cdocar") != 0)
	{
		DestroyDynamic3DVehicle( cdotext[GetPVarInt(playerid,"cdocar")], GetPVarInt(playerid,"cdocar") );
		cdo[GetPVarInt(playerid,"cdocar")] = false;
	}
    if(strlen(mInfo[playerid][mdo1])>1) DeleteDynamic3DText(mInfo[playerid][mdotext][0]);
    if(strlen(mInfo[playerid][mdo2])>1) DeleteDynamic3DText(mInfo[playerid][mdotext][1]);
    if(strlen(mInfo[playerid][mdo3])>1) DeleteDynamic3DText(mInfo[playerid][mdotext][2]);
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"jobcar")!=0) SetVehicleToRespawn(GetPVarInt(playerid,"jobcar"));
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"motorent")!=0)
	{
		DestroyVehicleNew(playersellcar[playerid]);
		milleage[playersellcar[playerid]] = 0.0;
		Gas[playersellcar[playerid]] = 0.0;
		playersellcar[playerid]=EOS;
		TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid,salon[0]); TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid,salon[1]); TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid,salon[2]); TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid,salon[3]);
		TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid,salon[6]); TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid,salon[7]); TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid,salon[9]); TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid,salon[10]); TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid,motorent);
		DeletePVar(playerid,"motorent");
	}

	if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"editfrakobject") == 1 )
	{
	    DestroyDynamicObjected( eobj[playerid] );
	    eobj[playerid] = EOS;
	}
    if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"editobject") == 1 )
    {
	    DestroyDynamicObjected(eobj[playerid]);
	    eobj[playerid] = EOS;
	}
	if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"fursel") == 1 )
    {
	    DestroyPlayerObject( playerid, fInfo[ GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid") ][ fObjectid ][ GetPVarInt( playerid, "furslot" ) ] );
	    fInfo[ GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid") ][ fObjectid ][ GetPVarInt( playerid, "furslot" ) ] = EOS;
	    fInfo[ GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid") ][ fObject ][ GetPVarInt( playerid, "furslot" ) ] = EOS;
	}
	if( furnitureid[ playerid ] != 0 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"fshop") == 1)
	{
		DestroyPlayerObject( playerid, furnitureid[ playerid ] );
		furnitureid[ playerid ] = EOS;
	}

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"editcarattach") != 0)
	{
        if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"editcarattach") == 1)
		{
		    new
				i = GetPVarInt( playerid, "editattachcar"),
				car = GetPVarInt( playerid, "attachcar"),
   				Float:px, Float:py, Float:pz;

			GetVehiclePos(cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], px, py, pz);
            AttachDynamicObjectToVehicle(cInfo[ car ][ cAttachID ][ i ], cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], px, py, pz + 1.3, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);

            cInfo[ car ][ cObjectX ][ i ] = px,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectY ][ i ] = py,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectZ ][ i ] = pz + 1.3,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfX ][ i ] = 0.0,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfY ][ i ] = 0.0,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfZ ][ i ] = 0.0;

			SaveCarAttach( car );

		}
		else if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"editcarattach") == 2)
		{
			new
				i = GetPVarInt( playerid, "editattachcar"),
				car = GetPVarInt( playerid, "attachcar");

			DestroyDynamicObjected( cInfo[ car ][ cAttachID ][ i ] );

			cInfo[ car ][ cAttachID ][ i ] = 0;
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectInv ][ i ] = 0;
			cInfo[ car ][ cAttachObject ][ i ] = 0;

			SaveCarAttach( car );
		}
	}

    for(new id; id < MAX_VIZ; id ++)
	{
		if(viInfo[id][viPlayerid]!=playerid && viInfo[id][viEnter]!=1) continue;
	    viInfo[id][viID]=id;
		viInfo[id][viPlayerid]=0;
		viInfo[id][viEnter]=0;
		viInfo[id][viPos][0]=0;
		viInfo[id][viPos][1]=0;
		viInfo[id][viPos][2]=0;
		strmid(viInfo[id][viText], "0", 0, strlen("0"), 70), vizov--;
		if(vizov<0) vizov=0;
		break;
    }

    for(new za; za != LoadAllCar; za++)
   	{
   	    if(!strcmp(cInfo[za][cOwner],pInfo[playerid][pName],true))
		{
		    if( cInfo[ za ][ cArrest ] != 1 )
		    {
				if( cInfo[ za ][ cTime ] == 0 ) cInfo[ za ][ cTime ] = gettime()+43200;
			}

			// выключение музыки, если владелец вышел
			if(cInfo[za][cMusic][1] != 0)
			{
			    foreach(Player, i)
				{
					if(IsPlayerInDynamicArea(playerid,cInfo[za][cMusic][2])) StopAudioStreamForPlayer(i);
				}

				if(IsValidDynamicArea(cInfo[za][cMusic][2])) DestroyDynamicArea(cInfo[za][cMusic][2]), cInfo[GetPVarInt(playerid,"cmenuid")][cMusic][2] = 0;
			 	cInfo[za][cMusic][1] = 0;
			}
		}
	}

    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"motoid")!=0) konecmoto(playerid);

    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxi")==1 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxitype")!=0)
	{
		if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"perevoz")==1)
		{
			DeletePVar( GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxip") , "taxipp"   );
			DeletePVar( GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxip") , "pperevoz" );
			RemovePlayerFromVehicle( GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxip") );
			SetVehicleToRespawn( GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxip") );
		}
		textdrawtaxi(playerid,0,0,0,1,0,0);
		tdriver--;
		textupdate();
	}

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"hand") != 0) RemovePlayerAttachedObject(playerid, 9);

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"pperevoz")==1)
	{
		new dr = GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxipp");
		GiveMoney(playerid,-GetPVarInt(dr,"plata"));
		SetPVarInt(dr,"zarplata",GetPVarInt(dr,"zarplata")+GetPVarInt(dr,"plata"));

		pformat:( "Вы получили "C_GRAY"%d руб",GetPVarInt(dr,"plata"));
		psend:( playerid, COLOR_WHITE );

		textdrawtaxi(dr,0,0,0,0,0,1);
		DeletePVar(dr,"perevoz");
		DeletePVar(dr,"s");
		DeletePVar(dr,"plata");
		DeletePVar(dr,"taxip");
		DeletePVar(dr,"zarplata");
	}

	for(new i; i != 3; i ++)
	{
		if(aObj[playerid][aSlot][i] != 0)
		{
			aObj[playerid][aSlot][i] = 0;
			aObj[playerid][aObject][i] = 0;
			aObj[playerid][aBone][i] = 0;
			aObj[playerid][aX][i] = 0.0;
			aObj[playerid][aY][i] = 0.0;
			aObj[playerid][aZ][i] = 0.0;
			aObj[playerid][aFX][i] = 0.0;
			aObj[playerid][aFY][i] = 0.0;
			aObj[playerid][aFZ][i] = 0.0;
		}
	}

	// ВРЕМЯ И ДАТА, ПОЗИЦИЯ, КОГДА ВЫШЕЛ
    new c,m,s,d,y,me,Float:pos1,Float:pos2,Float:pos3,Float:pos4; getdate(y,me,d); gettime(c,m,s);  // if(m>50 && c!=23) c++;

	if(reason == 0) format:str_least("вылет/краш");
	if(reason == 1) format:str_least("вышел");
	if(reason == 2) format:str_least("кик/бан");

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"spec") != 1)
	{
	    format:str_small("(( %s[%d] покинул игру. Причина: %s ))",pInfo[playerid][pName],playerid,str_least);
		ProxDetector(20.0,playerid,str_small,0x858585FF,0x858585FF,0x858585FF,0x858585FF,0x858585FF);
	}
	SaveFrak(playerid);
	SaveWeapon(playerid);
	viptime[playerid] = 0;

	GetPlayerPos(playerid,pos1,pos2,pos3); GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerid,pos4);

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"mask") != 0)
	{
	    GivePlayerItem(playerid,378,1);
	    DestroyDynamic3DPlayer( mask[playerid], playerid );
	}
	if(AdminDuty[playerid]!=false)
	{
	    DestroyDynamic3DPlayer( adutytxd[playerid], playerid );
	    AdminDuty[playerid] = false;
	}

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"mute") !=0 )
	{
		mysql_format:str_small("UPDATE `" #DB_ACCOUNTS "` SET `Mute` = '%d' WHERE `Name` = '%s'",GetPVarInt(playerid,"mute"), pInfo[playerid][pName]);
		mysql_function_query(mysql_connect_ID, str_small, false, "", "");
	}
	if(pInfo[playerid][pArrest]!=0)
	{
		mysql_format:str_small("UPDATE `" #DB_ACCOUNTS "` SET `Arrest` = '%d' WHERE `Name` = '%s'",pInfo[playerid][pArrest], pInfo[playerid][pName]);
		mysql_function_query(mysql_connect_ID, str_small, false, "", "");
	}
	if(pInfo[playerid][pJailTime]!=0)
	{
		mysql_format:str_small("UPDATE `" #DB_ACCOUNTS "` SET `JailTime` = '%d' WHERE `Name` = '%s'",pInfo[playerid][pJailTime], pInfo[playerid][pName]);
		mysql_function_query(mysql_connect_ID, str_small, false, "", "");
	}
    if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"skinshop") == 0 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"buycar") == 0 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"skinchange") == 0 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"fshop") == 0)
    {
		mysql_format:str_cmd("UPDATE `" #DB_ACCOUNTS "` SET `Time` = '%d|%d', `Pos` = '%f|%f|%f|%f', `Virt` = '%d' WHERE `Name` = '%s'",c,d,pos1,pos2,pos3,pos4,GetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerid),pInfo[playerid][pName]);
		mysql_function_query(mysql_connect_ID, str_cmd, false, "", "");
	}

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"duty") == 1)
	{
        mysql_format:str_small("UPDATE `" #DB_ACCOUNTS "` SET `Fskin` = '%d' WHERE `ID` = '%d'",GetPlayerSkin(playerid),pInfo[playerid][pID]);
		mysql_function_query(mysql_connect_ID, str_small, false, "", "");
		str_small[0] = EOS;
    }
    if(pInfo[playerid][pJailTime] > 0)
	{
    	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"afk") >= 300) return SCM(playerid, COLOR_LIGHT_RED,"Вы были автоматически отключены от сервера из-за пребывания в AFK в деморгане более 5 минут!"), Kick(playerid);
	}

	new year, month, day;
	getdate(year, month, day);
	mysql_format:str_small("UPDATE `" #DB_ACCOUNTS "` SET `Lastip` = '%s', `Lastdate` = '%d|%d|%d' WHERE `ID` = '%d'", pInfo[playerid][pLastip], day, month, year, pInfo[playerid][pID]);

	str_small[0] = EOS;

	foreach(Player, i)
	{

			    Specoff( i );
			}
		}
	}

	cmd::c(playerid);


	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerSpawn(playerid)
{

    SetPlayerColor(playerid,0xFFFFFF00);
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"skinchange")==1)
	{
		TogglePlayerSpectating(playerid,0);
		TogglePlayerControllable(playerid,0);
		SetPlayerPos(playerid,-439.4579,488.4408,12.2623), SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerid,177.1106);
		InterpolateCameraPos(playerid, -439.122314, 470.127014, 14.394392, -439.122314, 470.127014, 14.394392, 1000);
        InterpolateCameraLookAt(playerid, -439.192626, 475.079315, 13.709055, -439.192626, 475.079315, 13.709055, 1000);
		SetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerid,playerid+1);
		SCM(playerid,COLOR_DARK_GRAY,"Используйте стрелки, чтобы выбрать внешний вид своего персонажа");
		SCM(playerid,COLOR_DARK_GRAY,"Внешний вид должен соответствовать вашей роли. В противном случае Вас могут наказать");
		for(new z; z != 6; z++) TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid,tskinc[z]);
	    SelectTextDraw(playerid,0xFF0000FF);
		return 1;
	}

    //cef_create_browser(playerid, BROWSER_ID, "https://irugree-debug.github.io/cef_green-2/index.html", false, false);
	cef_create_browser(playerid, BROWSER_ID, "https://irugree-debug.github.io/modern/index.html", false, false);
	cef_create_browser(playerid, TONIK_BROWSER_ID, "http://forum.delta-rp.ru/GreentechHUD.html", true, false);

	cef_create_browser(playerid, BROWSER_DOKI_ID, "http://forum.delta-rp.ru/cef/index.html", true, false);

// Показываем блок денег
	cef_emit_event(playerid, "interface:show", "money");
	// Устанавливаем значение из pBank
	cef_emit_event(playerid, "interface:set:card", pInfo[playerid][pBank]);

	cef_emit_event(playerid, "notifical:player:data",
    CEFSTR("Тест спавна"),
    CEFSTR("1"),
    CEFSTR("success"),
    CEFINT(1),
     CEFINT(5000)
	 );

// Если игрок в стадии (death > 0)
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid, "death") > 0)
    {
        // 1. Телепортируем его на сохраненные координаты
        SetPlayerPos(playerid, pInfo[playerid][pCor][0], pInfo[playerid][pCor][1], pInfo[playerid][pCor][2]);
        SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerid, pInfo[playerid][pCor][3]);

        // 2. Снова замораживаем и ставим анимацию
        TogglePlayerControllable(playerid, false);
        if(GetPVarInt(playerid, "death") == 1)
            ApplyAnimation(playerid, "CRACK", "crckdeth2", 4.1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0);
        else
            ApplyAnimation(playerid, "PED", "KO_shot_front", 4.1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0);

        return 1;
    }
    new str[128];
    format(str, sizeof(str), "  {FFFFFF}Добро пожаловать, {4D9AFF}%s %s{FFFFFF}, рады видеть вас снова!",
    pInfo[playerid][pRusname],
    pInfo[playerid][pSurname]);

// Сначала "чистим" уши игроку, чтобы не было наложения
    for(new i = 0; i < 20; i++) Audio_Stop(playerid, i);

    new Float:x, Float:y, Float:z;
    for(new vid = 1; vid < MAX_VEHICLES; vid++)
    {
        // Если в машине играет музыка (есть handle)
        if(g_VehicleAudioHandle[vid] != -1)
        {
            GetVehiclePos(vid, x, y, z);

            // Если он заспавнился рядом с этой машиной
            if(IsPlayerInRangeOfPoint(playerid, 100.0, x, y, z))
            {
                // Запускаем ему тот же трек, что и в машине
                new streamid = Audio_PlayStreamed(playerid, g_VehicleAudioURL[vid]);
                Audio_Set3DPosition(playerid, streamid, x, y, z, 100.0);
            }
        }
    }

    Logotype[playerid] = TextDrawCreate(580.000000, -16.177778, "apack:abilityproject");
	TextDrawLetterSize(Logotype[playerid], 0.000000, 0.000000);
	TextDrawTextSize(Logotype[playerid], 58.500000, 66.577774);
	TextDrawAlignment(Logotype[playerid], 1);
	TextDrawColor(Logotype[playerid], -1);
	TextDrawSetShadow(Logotype[playerid], 0);
	TextDrawSetOutline(Logotype[playerid], 0);
    TextDrawFont(Logotype[playerid], 4);
    TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, Logotype[playerid]);

	new c,m;
	gettime(c,m,_);
	SetPlayerTime(playerid,c,m);

    PreloadAnimLib(playerid,"CRACK");
    PreloadAnimLib(playerid,"WEAPONS");
    PreloadAnimLib(playerid,"GANGS");
    PreloadAnimLib(playerid,"MISC");

    if(hour == 00 && minute == 00 && second == 00)

    if((hour%2) != 0 && minute == 00 && second == 00)

public OnPlayerGiveDamage(playerid, damagedid, Float:amount, weaponid)
{
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"gLogged")!=1) return 1;
    if(GetPVarInt(damagedid,"gLogged")!=1) return 1;
    if(GetPVarInt(damagedid,"death")>0) return 1;
    if(damagetime[damagedid]!=0) return 1;


    if(weaponid>=35 && weaponid<=38) return 1;

	if(playerid != INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
	{
		if(weaponid>54) return 1;
	    new tdeath1,tdeath2,tdeath3;
		new dtime[7];
		gettime(tdeath1,tdeath2,tdeath3);
		damagetime[damagedid]=2;
	    for(new i; i !=10; i++)
		{
			if(dInfo[damagedid][dGun][i] == 0)
			{
				dInfo[damagedid][dGun][i] = weaponid;
				dInfo[damagedid][dType][i] = 1;
				f(dtime),"%d:%d|",tdeath1,tdeath2);
				strins(dInfo[damagedid][dTime],dtime,strlen(dInfo[damagedid][dTime]),128);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
    return 1;
}

public OnPlayerDeath(playerid, killerid, reason)
{
    // Если игрок еще не в стадии, мы принудительно его туда закидываем
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid, "death") == 0)
    {
        // Принудительно ставим HP обратно, чтобы сервер не закончил смерть
        SetPlayerHealth(playerid, 10.0);

        // Запускаем стадию

        // ВАЖНО: возвращаем 0, чтобы сервер не спавнил игрока
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

public OnVehicleDeath(vehicleid, killerid)
{
	VehSiren[vehicleid][vSiren] = true;
	VehSiren[vehicleid][vSirenState] = 0;
	if(VehSiren[vehicleid][vIskra]!=false) KillTimer(VehSiren[vehicleid][vIskraTimer]);
	VehSiren[vehicleid][vIskra]=false;

  	Gas[vehicleid] = 50.0;

	for( new i; i != LoadAllCar; i++ )
	{
		if( vehicleid == cInfo[i][cCar] )
		{
			cInfo[i][cHealth] = 450.0;
			cInfo[i][cEngine] = 1;
			GetVehicleDamageStatus(cInfo[i][cCar], cInfo[i][cDamage][0], cInfo[i][cDamage][1], cInfo[i][cDamage][2], cInfo[i][cDamage][3]);

			mysql_format:str_big( "UPDATE `" #DB_CARS "` SET `health` = '%f', `damage` = '%d|%d|%d|%d', `engine` = '%d' WHERE `ID` = '%d'",
					cInfo[i][cHealth],
					cInfo[i][cDamage][0],
					cInfo[i][cDamage][1],
					cInfo[i][cDamage][2],
					cInfo[i][cDamage][3],
					cInfo[i][cEngine],
					cInfo[i][cID]
					);

			mysql_tquery( mysql_connect_ID, str_big, "", "" );
			break;
		}
	}

	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerText(playerid, text[])
{
    ClearVar();

    if(GetPVarInt(playerid, "gLogged") != 1) return false;
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"death")==2) return false;

    if(realchat == true)
	{
	    if(strlen(text) > 128) return false;
	    if(strfind( text , ".tk" , true ) != -1 ||  strfind( text , ".com" , true ) != -1 ||  strfind( text , "3dn.ru" , true ) != -1 ||  strfind( text , ".ru" , true ) != -1 ||  strfind( text , ".net" , true ) != -1

                    format(mess, 100, "...%s",string), ProxDetector(10.0, playerid, mess, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
				}

		  			else format(text, 104, "Неизвестный [%d] говорит: %s...", GetPVarInt(playerid,"mask"), text), ProxDetector(20.0, playerid, text, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
		  			format(mess, 100, "...%s",string), ProxDetector(20.0, playerid, mess, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
		    	}
			}
			else
			{
		  		new string[128];
		    	new mess[128];
		    	strmid(string,text,64,128,128);
		   	 	strdel(text,64,128);
		    	if(IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid) && WindowCar[GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)] == 0)
				{

					else format(text, 123, "%s %s говорит (окно закрыто): %s...", pInfo[playerid][pRusname], pInfo[playerid][pSurname], text), ProxDetector(10.0, playerid, text, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
					format(mess, 100, "...%s",string), ProxDetector(10.0, playerid, mess, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
				}
				else
				{
					if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"Alkohol") > 0) format(text, 104, "%s %s говорит(запах перегара изо рта): %s...", pInfo[playerid][pRusname], pInfo[playerid][pSurname], text), ProxDetector(20.0, playerid, text, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
					else format(text, 104, "%s %s говорит: %s...", pInfo[playerid][pRusname], pInfo[playerid][pSurname], text), ProxDetector(20.0, playerid, text, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
					format(mess, 100, "...%s",string), ProxDetector(20.0, playerid, mess, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
				}
			}
        }
        else
        {
            if(AdminDuty[playerid] == true)
            {
		  		format:str_small("Администратор [%s]: %s", pInfo[playerid][pAdmnomer], text);
				ProxDetector(10.0, playerid, str_small, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
				SetPlayerChatBubble(playerid,text,COLOR_WHITE,10.0,10000);
                return false;
			}
            if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"mask") != 0)
            {
            	if(IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid) && WindowCar[GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)] == 0)
            	{
					if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"Alkohol") > 0) format:str_small("Неизвестный [%d] говорит (окно закрыто)(запах перегара изо рта): %s", GetPVarInt(playerid,"mask"), text);
					else format:str_small("Неизвестный [%d] говорит (ОКНО ЗАКРЫТО): %s", GetPVarInt(playerid,"mask"), text);
					ProxDetector(10.0, playerid, str_small, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
					SetPlayerChatBubble(playerid,text,COLOR_WHITE,10.0,10000);
				}
		    	else
				{
					if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"Alkohol") > 0) format:str_small("Неизвестный [%d] говорит(запах перегара изо рта): %s", GetPVarInt(playerid,"mask"), text);
					else format:str_small("Неизвестный [%d] говорит: %s", GetPVarInt(playerid,"mask"), text);
					ProxDetector(20.0, playerid, str_small, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
					SetPlayerChatBubble(playerid,text,COLOR_WHITE,20.0,10000);
				}
            }
            else
            {
			    if(IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid) && WindowCar[GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)] == 0)
			    {
					if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"Alkohol") > 0) format:str_small("%s %s говорит (окно закрыто)(запах перегара изо рта): %s", pInfo[playerid][pRusname], pInfo[playerid][pSurname], text);
					else format:str_small("%s %s говорит (окно закрыто): %s", pInfo[playerid][pRusname], pInfo[playerid][pSurname], text);
					ProxDetector(10.0, playerid, str_small, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
					SetPlayerChatBubble(playerid,text,COLOR_WHITE,10.0,10000);
				}
		    	else
		    	{
					if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"Alkohol") > 0) format:str_small("%s %s говорит(запах перегара изо рта): %s", pInfo[playerid][pRusname], pInfo[playerid][pSurname], text);
					else format:str_small("%s %s говорит: %s", pInfo[playerid][pRusname], pInfo[playerid][pSurname], text);
					ProxDetector(20.0, playerid, str_small, COLOR_FADE1,COLOR_FADE2,COLOR_FADE3,COLOR_FADE4,COLOR_FADE5);
					SetPlayerChatBubble(playerid,text,COLOR_WHITE,20.0,10000);
				}
			}
	    }

	    if(GetPlayerAnimationIndex(playerid)==1189 || GetPlayerAnimationIndex(playerid)==1275)
		{
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==0) ApplyAnimation(playerid,"PED","IDLE_CHAT",8.1,0,1,1,1,1);
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==1) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,596,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==2) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,597,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==3) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,598,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==4) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,599,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==5) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,600,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==6) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,601,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==7) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,602,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==8) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,603,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==9) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,798,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAnim]==10) ApplyAnimationIndex(playerid,800,4.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 );
			SetTimerEx("ClearAnimText", 1500, false, "d", playerid);
		}
	}
	return false;
}

public OnPlayerCommandReceived(playerid, cmdtext[])
{
	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"gLogged") == 0) return 0;
	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"AntiFlood") > gettime())

	ClearVar();
	printf("LOGS:COMMAND [%s] %s",pInfo[playerid][pName],cmdtext);
	return 1;
}
public OnPlayerCommandPerformed(playerid, cmdtext[], success)
{
	if(success == -1)
        return SendClientMessage(playerid, COLOR_RED, "[СИСТЕМА]: {FFFFFF}Вы ввели несуществующую команду!");
	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerEnterVehicle(playerid, vehicleid, ispassenger)
{
    //ShowPlayerSpeedometer(playerid);
	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"death") == 1 || GetPVarInt(playerid,"death") == 2) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SetPlayerPos(playerid, pInfo[playerid][pCor][0], pInfo[playerid][pCor][1], pInfo[playerid][pCor][2]), ApplyAnimation(playerid, "CRACK", "crckdeth2", 4.1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0);
	if(ResVeh[vehicleid][Status]==true) SetPVarInt(playerid,"resvehid",vehicleid), SPD(playerid,dResVeh,DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX,"Респавн","Данный транспорт находиться на стадии респавна\nХотите ли вы снять стадию?","Снять","Оставить");
	if(cInfo[vehicleid][cMusic]==1) PlayAudioStreamForPlayer(playerid, carmusic[vehicleid]);
    if(ispassenger) return 1;
	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerExitVehicle(playerid, vehicleid)
{
    if(vehicleid >= acar_b[0] && vehicleid <= acar_b[2]) { if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"go")==2 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"ekzamen")==1) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы провалили ваш экзамен"), SetVehicleToRespawn(vehicleid), DeletePVar(playerid,"go"), DeletePVar(playerid,"LESSON"), DeletePVar(playerid,"practicexam"), DeletePVar(playerid,"oshibka"), DeletePVar(playerid,"testnum"), DeletePVar(playerid,"ekzamen"),DisablePlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid); }
    if(vehicleid >= acar_a[0] && vehicleid <= acar_a[2]) { if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"go")==1 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"ekzamen")==1) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы провалили ваш экзамен"), SetVehicleToRespawn(vehicleid), DeletePVar(playerid,"go"), DeletePVar(playerid,"LESSON"), DeletePVar(playerid,"practicexam"), DeletePVar(playerid,"oshibka"), DeletePVar(playerid,"testnum"), DeletePVar(playerid,"ekzamen"),DisablePlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid); }
    if(vehicleid == acar_c[0]) { if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"go")==3 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"ekzamen")==1) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы провалили ваш экзамен"), SetVehicleToRespawn(vehicleid), DeletePVar(playerid,"go"), DeletePVar(playerid,"LESSON"), DeletePVar(playerid,"practicexam"), DeletePVar(playerid,"oshibka"), DeletePVar(playerid,"testnum"), DeletePVar(playerid,"ekzamen"),DisablePlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid); }
    if(vehicleid == acar_d[0]) { if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"go")==4 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"ekzamen")==1) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы провалили ваш экзамен"), SetVehicleToRespawn(vehicleid), DeletePVar(playerid,"go"), DeletePVar(playerid,"LESSON"), DeletePVar(playerid,"practicexam"), DeletePVar(playerid,"oshibka"), DeletePVar(playerid,"testnum"), DeletePVar(playerid,"ekzamen"),DisablePlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid); }

    if(IsWorkingBus[playerid] && vehicleid == GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)) // Проверка, что вышел из своего автобуса
    {
        IsPausedBus[playerid] = true; // Ставим работу на паузу
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFF00AA, "Вы вышли из автобуса! У вас есть 20 секунд, чтобы вернуться.");

        // Запускаем таймер на 20 секунд
        BusTimer[playerid] = SetTimerEx("CheckBusReturn", 20000, false, "i", playerid);
    }


	if(vehicleid == GetPVarInt(playerid,"jobcar"))
	{
		SetPVarInt(playerid,"stopj",20), SCM(playerid,-1,"{F04223}У Вас есть 20 секунд, чтобы вернуться за руль, иначе вашу зарплату аннулируют");
	}

	if(vehicleid >= truck[0] && vehicleid <= truck[1] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"truck")==1) SetPVarInt(playerid,"deltruck",61), SCM(playerid,-1,"Если вы уйдете далеко от фуры, ваша зарплата будет аннулирована");
	if(vehicleid >= taxi[0] && vehicleid <= taxi[1] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxi")==1 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxitype")!=0) SetPVarInt(playerid,"deltaxi2",61), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вернитесь в автомобиль, иначе ваша зарплата будет аннулирована");
	if(vehicleid >= taxi[0] && vehicleid <= taxi[1] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)!=0)
	{
		new dr=GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxipp");
		if(GetPVarInt(GetPVarInt(playerid,"taxipp"),"plata")==0) return textdrawtaxi(dr,0,0,0,0,0,1), DeletePVar(dr,"perevoz"),DeletePVar(dr,"s"),DeletePVar(dr,"plata"),DeletePVar(dr,"taxip"),DeletePVar(playerid,"taxipp"),DeletePVar(playerid,"pperevoz");

        pformat:( "{FFD918}Вы покинули такси и заплатил водителю %d руб",GetPVarInt(dr,"plata"));
		psend:( playerid, COLOR_WHITE );

		pformat:( "{FFD918}%s покинул ваше такси и заплатил Вам %d руб",pInfo[playerid][pName],GetPVarInt(dr,"plata"));
		psend:( dr, COLOR_WHITE );

		GiveMoney(playerid,-GetPVarInt(dr,"plata"));

	    SetPVarInt(dr,"zarplata",GetPVarInt(dr,"zarplata")+GetPVarInt(dr,"plata")),
		textdrawtaxi(dr,0,0,0,0,0,1),
		DeletePVar(dr,"perevoz"),
		DeletePVar(dr,"s"),
		DeletePVar(dr,"plata"),
		DeletePVar(dr,"taxip"),
		DeletePVar(playerid,"taxipp"),
		DeletePVar(playerid,"pperevoz");
    }
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"remen") == 1) SetPVarInt(playerid,"remen",0), cmd::ame(playerid,"Отстегнул ремень безопасности");
    if(vehicleid == GetPVarInt(playerid,"motoid")) SetPVarInt(playerid,"delmoto",120);


	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerStateChange(playerid, newstate, oldstate)
{
	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"gLogged")!=1) return 1;
    new newcar = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"death")!=0 && IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid)) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SetPlayerPos(playerid, pInfo[playerid][pCor][0], pInfo[playerid][pCor][1], pInfo[playerid][pCor][2]), ApplyAnimation(playerid, "CRACK", "crckdeth2", 4.1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0);
    if(pInfo[playerid][pArrest]!=0 && IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid)) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SetPlayerPosF(playerid,-704.7502,503.9217,8.9030,360.0000);
	if(pInfo[playerid][pJailTime]!=0 && IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid)) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SetPlayerPos(playerid,2542.0298,-2411.0325,25.2629);
	if(KATSystem==true)
	{
		if(IsKatC(playerid,newcar) && pInfo[playerid][pLic][2]!=2 && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid),SCM(playerid,-1,"Получите категорию C");
	    if(IsKatD(playerid,newcar) && pInfo[playerid][pLic][3]!=2 && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid),SCM(playerid,-1,"Получите категорию D");
	    if(IsKatB(playerid,newcar) && pInfo[playerid][pLic][1]!=2 && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid),SCM(playerid,-1,"Получите категорию B");
	    if(IsKatA(playerid,newcar) && pInfo[playerid][pLic][0]!=2 && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid),SCM(playerid,-1,"Получите категорию A");
	}
	if(GetVehicleModel(newcar)==462)
	{

		if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"motoid")==newcar)
		{
			DeletePVar(playerid,"delmoto");
		}
		else
		{
			foreach(Player, i)
		    {
		    	if(GetPVarInt(i,"motoid")==newcar && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)!=0) { RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid); SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нет ключей от этого транспорта!"); break; }
		    }
	    }

	}
	if(newstate == PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER && IsPausedBus[playerid])
    {
        // Игрок сел обратно! Отменяем таймер
        KillTimer(BusTimer[playerid]);
        IsPausedBus[playerid] = false;
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "Вы вернулись в автобус, работа продолжается.");
    }
// Игрок сел за руль
    if(newstate == PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER)
    {
        // Отправляем событие в CEF для показа
        cef_emit_event(playerid, "modern:speed:visible");
    }

    // Игрок вышел из машины (из любого состояния)
    if(oldstate == PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER && newstate != PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER)
    {
        // Отправляем событие в CEF для скрытия
        cef_emit_event(playerid, "modern:speed:hidden");
    }
	if(newcar >= bustaxi[0] && newcar <= bustaxi[9])
    {
	    if(pInfo[playerid][pJob][0]!=1) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid); //SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы не являетесь сотрудником " #C_GRAY "\"ЮжныйТранс\"");
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"bjob")!=1) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы не начали свой рабочий день");
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"bjob")==1 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"bcheck")>=1) { if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)!=GetPVarInt(playerid,"jobcar")) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Это не ваш рабочий транспорт"); }
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"bjob")==1 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"bcheck")<1) SPD(playerid,dJob+4,list,"" #C_GRAY "Выберите маршрут","" #C_GRAY "1.{ffffff} Маршрут №12\n" #C_GRAY "2.{ffffff} Маршрут №27","Ок","");
	    if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)==GetPVarInt(playerid,"jobcar")) SetPVarInt(playerid,"stopj",0);
	}


	if(newcar >= taxi[0] && newcar <= taxi[1] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)!=0)
	{
	    foreach(Player, i)
	    {
		    if(GetPVarInt(i,"idtaxi")!=GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)) continue;
			if(GetPlayerVehicleSeat(i)==0 && GetPlayerVehicleID(i)==GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid))
			{
				for(new id; id < MAX_VIZ; id ++)
				{
					if(viInfo[id][viPlayerid]==playerid && viInfo[id][viEnter]==1) viInfo[id][viEnter]=0,viInfo[id][viPos][0]=0,viInfo[id][viPos][1]=0,viInfo[id][viPos][2]=0,viInfo[id][viPlayerid]=0, strmid(viInfo[id][viText], "0", 0, strlen("0"), 70), vizov--; if(vizov<0) vizov=0;
				}

				SetPVarInt(i,"taxip",playerid), SetPVarInt(playerid,"taxipp",i);
				SCM(i,-1,"{FFD918}В ваше такси сел пассажир {ffffff}(( Чтобы выгнать человека из автомобиля, введите /eject [id] ))"), SCM(i,-1,"Подождите, пока игрок определит: показать Вам место на gps или объяснить на словах");
				SPD(playerid,dTaxi,list,"" #C_GRAY "Выберите маршрут","" #C_GRAY "1. {ffffff}Выбрать отметку из GPS\n" #C_GRAY "2. {ffffff}Объяснить водителю на словах","Ок","Выйти");
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	//if(newcar >= mcs[0] && newcar <= mcs[11] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(pInfo[playerid][pFrak]!=5) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нету ключей от этого транспорта!"); }
	//if(newcar >= fkc[0] && newcar <= fkc[10] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(pInfo[playerid][pFrak]!=6) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нету ключей от этого транспорта!"); }
	//if(newcar >= trk[0] && newcar <= trk[5] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(pInfo[playerid][pFrak]!=10) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нету ключей от этого транспорта!"); }
	//if(newcar >= ymvd[0] && newcar <= ymvd[36] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(pInfo[playerid][pFrak]!=1) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нет ключа от этого автомобиля"); }
	//if(newcar >= vdv[0] && newcar <= vdv[18] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(pInfo[playerid][pFrak]!=8) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нет ключа от этого автомобиля"); }
	//if(newcar >= uchastmvd[0] && newcar <= uchastmvd[0] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(GetPVarInt(playerid, "UPP") == 0) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нет ключа от этого автомобиля"); }
	//if(newcar >= uchastokb[0] && newcar <= uchastokb[3] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(GetPVarInt(playerid, "UOKB") == 0) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нет ключа от этого автомобиля"); }
	//if(newcar >= stroyka[0] && newcar <= stroyka[4] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(GetPVarInt(playerid, "poezd") == 0) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нет ключа от этого автомобиля"); }
	//if(newcar >= sled[0] && newcar <= sled[9] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(pInfo[playerid][pFrak]!=7) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нет ключа от этого автомобиля"); }
	//if(newcar >= prokur[0] && newcar <= prokur[4] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(pInfo[playerid][pFrak]!=9) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нет ключа от этого автомобиля"); }
	if(newcar >= sud[1] && newcar <= sud[3] && GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerid)==0) { if(pInfo[playerid][pFrak]!=19) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"У Вас нет ключа от этого автомобиля"); }
	if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) >= acar_b[0] && GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) <= acar_b[2]) // Легковушки
	{
		if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"go")==2 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"ekzamen")==1 ) SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK1,B_CHECK2,7.0), SetPVarInt(playerid,"practicexam",1), SetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON",1);
    	else return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы не сдаете на права или это не ваша категория");
	}

	if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) >= acar_a[0] && GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) <= acar_a[2]) // Мотоциклы
	{
		if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"go")==1 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"ekzamen")==1 ) SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK1,B_CHECK2,7.0), SetPVarInt(playerid,"practicexam",1), SetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON",1);
    	else return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы не сдаете на права или это не ваша категория");
	}

	if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) == acar_c[0]) // Камазы
	{
		if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"go")==3 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"ekzamen")==1 ) SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK1,B_CHECK2,7.0), SetPVarInt(playerid,"practicexam",1), SetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON",1);
    	else return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы не сдаете на права или это не ваша категория");
	}

	if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) == acar_d[0]) // Автобусы
	{
		if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"go")==4 && GetPVarInt(playerid,"ekzamen")==1 ) SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK1,B_CHECK2,7.0), SetPVarInt(playerid,"practicexam",1), SetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON",1);
    	else return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы не сдаете на права или это не ваша категория");
	}

	// СПИДОМЕТР
	if(newstate == PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER)
    {
        /*for(new z; z != LoadAllCar; z++)
		{
			if(!strcmp(cInfo[z][cOwner],pInfo[playerid][pName],true))
			{
		    	if(cInfo[z][cCar] == newcar)
		    	{
		    	    if(pInfo[playerid][pVip] == 0 && (cInfo[z][cModel] == 560 ||cInfo[z][cModel] == 580 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 400 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 466 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 579 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 604)) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Для того, чтобы сесть в данный автомобиль необходим ВИП аккаунт!");
		    	    else if(pInfo[playerid][pVip] == 1 && (cInfo[z][cModel] == 580 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 400 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 466 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 579 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 604)) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Чтобы сесть в данный транспорт необходим более высокий уровень ВИП аккаунта!");
		    	    else if(pInfo[playerid][pVip] == 2 && (cInfo[z][cModel] == 400 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 466 || cInfo[z][cModel] == 579)) return RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid), SCM(playerid,-1,"Чтобы сесть в данный транспорт необходим более высокий уровень ВИП аккаунта!");
		    	}
			}
 		}
   */
	    new vehicleid = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
	    //cef_emit_event(playerid, "show_spedometr");
		cef_emit_event(playerid, "interface:update:fuel", Gas[vehicleid]);
		cef_emit_event(playerid, "interface:update:light", LightCar[vehicleid]);
		cef_emit_event(playerid, "interface:update:engine", EngineCar[vehicleid]);
		//for(new z; z != LoadAllCar; z++)
		{
			//if(cInfo[z][cLock]==0) cef_emit_event(playerid, "speed_update", CEFINT(3), CEFINT(0));
			//if(cInfo[z][cLock]==1) cef_emit_event(playerid, "speed_update", CEFINT(3), CEFINT(1));
		}
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"helpengine")==1)
	    {
			//SCM(playerid,0xAEAEAEFF,"Используйте клавишу {ffffff}\"2\" {AEAEAE}чтобы завести двигатель, команду {ffffff}\"/l\" чтобы включить фары{AEAEAE}и {ffffff}\"/rem\" {AEAEAE}чтобы пристегнуть ремень"), SCM(playerid,0xAEAEAEFF,"Чтобы открыть {ffffff}багажник/капот, {AEAEAE}подойдите к нему и нажмите клавишу {ffffff}\"Y\""), DeletePVar(playerid,"helpengine");
			//if( PlayerInCAR( playerid ) ) SCM(playerid,0xAEAEAEFF,"Левый поворотник - {ffffff}\"Q\" {AEAEAE}Правый поворотник - {ffffff}\"E\" {AEAEAE}Аварийный сигнал - {ffffff}\"NUM8\""); SCM(playerid,0xAEAEAEFF,"Для использования специальных звуковых сигналов используйте на NUMPAD - {ffffff}\"4\" и {ffffff}\"6\"");
			for(new i; i != sizeof sirenpos; i ++) // мигалки
			{
			    if(sirenpos[i][models] == GetVehicleModel(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)))
			    {
			    	if(GetVehicleModel(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)) == 611)
		    		{
			    	    if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) >= ymvd[0] && GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) <= ymvd[36]) return SCM(playerid,0xAEAEAEFF,"Чтобы включить/выключить проблесковые маячки, нажмите клавишу {ffffff}\"N\"");
						else return 1;
					}
			    	//SCM(playerid,0xAEAEAEFF,"Чтобы включить/выключить проблесковые маячки, нажмите клавишу {ffffff}\"N\"");
			    }
			}
		}
    }
	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerEditDynamicObject(playerid, objectid, response, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z, Float:rx, Float:ry, Float:rz)
{
	new
		Float:fX = x,
		Float:fY = y,
		Float:fZ = z,
		Float:fRotX = rx,
		Float:fRotY = ry,
		Float:fRotZ = rz
	;
	Streamer_Update(playerid);
    if( response == EDIT_RESPONSE_FINAL )
	{
	    if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"editobject") == 1 )
		{
			for(new i; i != MAX_OBJECTS_DROP; i ++)
			{
			    if(_objectInfo[i][objDrop][0] == 0 && _objectInfo[i][objDrop][1] == 0)
			    {
					_objectInfo[i][objDrop][0] = _invPlayer[playerid][invSlot][GetPVarInt(playerid,"selectSlot")];
					_objectInfo[i][objDrop][1] = 1; //_invPlayer[playerid][invSlotKol][GetPVarInt(playerid,"selectSlot")];
					_objectInfo[i][objPos][0] = fX;
					_objectInfo[i][objPos][1] = fY;
					_objectInfo[i][objPos][2] = fZ;
					_objectInfo[i][objObject] = objectid;
					_objectInfo[i][objWorld] = GetPlayerVirtualWorld( playerid );

					SetDynamicObjectPos(_objectInfo[i][objObject], fX, fY, fZ);
					SetDynamicObjectRot(_objectInfo[i][objObject], fRotX, fRotY, fRotZ);

					_objectInfo[i][objText] = CDT(_itemsInfo[_invPlayer[playerid][invSlot][GetPVarInt(playerid,"selectSlot")]][invName],0xFFFFFF50, _objectInfo[i][objPos][0],_objectInfo[i][objPos][1],_objectInfo[i][objPos][2],2.0,INVALID_PLAYER_ID,INVALID_VEHICLE_ID,0,GetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerid));

				    _invPlayer[playerid][invSlotKol][GetPVarInt(playerid,"selectSlot")]--;
				    if(_invPlayer[playerid][invSlotKol][GetPVarInt(playerid,"selectSlot")] <= 0) _invPlayer[playerid][invSlot][GetPVarInt(playerid,"selectSlot")]= 0;
				    SaveInventory(playerid);
				    SCM(playerid,0xB2EC5DFF,"Вы успешно положили предмет");
				    DeletePVar(playerid,"editobject");
					DeletePVar(playerid,"selectSlot");
					SCM(playerid, -1, "Чтобы поднять предмет, нажмите клавишу "C_GRAY"- H");

					break;
				}
			}
		}

		if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"editfrakobject")==1)
		{
			for(new i; i != MAX_FRAK_OBJ; i ++)
			{
			    if(fObj[i][objID] == 0 && fObj[i][objFrak] == 0)
			    {
					fObj[i][objPos][0] = fX;
					fObj[i][objPos][1] = fY;
					fObj[i][objPos][2] = fZ;
					fObj[i][objPlayer] = playerid;
					fObj[i][objID] = objectid;
					fObj[i][objFrak] = pInfo[playerid][pFrak];
					SetDynamicObjectPos(objectid, fX, fY, fZ);
					SetDynamicObjectRot(objectid, fRotX, fRotY, fRotZ);
					printf("Player: %s ID:%d",pInfo[playerid][pName],playerid);
					printf("OBJID:%d X: Y:%f Z:%f",objectid,fX,fY,fZ);
					printf("RX:%f RY:%f RZ:%f",fRotX,fRotY,fRotZ);


				    SCM(playerid,0xB2EC5DFF,"Вы успешно установили предмет");
				    SCM(playerid,0xB2EC5DFF,"Чтобы удалить предмет введите: /delobj или /fobj - установленные объекты");
				    DeletePVar(playerid,"editfrakobject");

					break;
				}
			}
		}

		if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"fursel") == 1 || GetPVarInt(playerid,"fursel") == 2 ) // установить / отредактировать
		{
		    new
				i = GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid"),
		    	id = GetPVarInt(playerid,"furslot");

			if( GetPlayerVirtualWorld( playerid ) != nInfo[ i ][ nInt ] ) return SCM( playerid, -1, "Вы должны находиться внутри вашей недвижимости!");
   			if( !IsPlayerInRangeOfPoint( playerid, 40.0, nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 0 ], nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 1 ], nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 2 ] ) )
   			{
   			    if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"fursel") == 1 )
				{
					DestroyDynamicObjected( fInfo[ GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid") ][ fObjectid ][ GetPVarInt( playerid, "furslot" ) ]);
				    fInfo[ GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid") ][ fObjectid ][ GetPVarInt( playerid, "furslot" ) ] = EOS;
				    fInfo[ GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid") ][ fObject ][ GetPVarInt( playerid, "furslot" ) ] = EOS;
				    DeletePVar( playerid, "fursel" );
					SetPlayerPosF( playerid, nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 0 ], nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 1 ], nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 2 ], nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 3 ]);
				}

				if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"fursel") == 2 )
				{
					SPD( playerid, dFurniture, list, " ","" #C_GRAY "•{FFFFFF} Отредактировать мебель\n" #C_GRAY "•{FFFFFF} Установить мебель","Ок","Назад");
				    DeletePVar( playerid, "fursel" );
				    SetPlayerPosF( playerid, nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 0 ], nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 1 ], nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 2 ], nInfo[ i ][ nExite ][ 3 ]);
				}
   				return SCM( playerid, -1, "Вы должны находиться внутри вашей недвижимости!");
			}

			SetDynamicObjectPos( fInfo[ i ][ fObjectid ][ id ], fX, fY, fZ );
			SetDynamicObjectRot( fInfo[ i ][ fObjectid ][ id ], fRotX, fRotY, fRotZ );

			_invPlayer[playerid][invSlotKol][GetPVarInt(playerid,"selectSlot")]--;
   			if(_invPlayer[playerid][invSlotKol][GetPVarInt(playerid,"selectSlot")] <= 0) _invPlayer[playerid][invSlot][GetPVarInt(playerid,"selectSlot")]= 0;
      		SaveInventory(playerid);

			SPD( playerid, dFurniture, list, " ","" #C_GRAY "•{FFFFFF} Отредактировать мебель\n" #C_GRAY "•{FFFFFF} Установить мебель","Ок","Назад");

			if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"fursel") == 1 )
			{
			    mysql_format:str_big( "\
				INSERT INTO `" #DB_FURNITURE "` \
					(`IDned`, `Object`, `X`, `Y`,`Z`, `RX`, `RY`,`RZ`) \
				VALUES \
					('%d', '%d', '%f', '%f', '%f', '%f', '%f', '%f')",
				nInfo[ i ][ nID ],
				fInfo[ i ][ fObject ][ id ],
				fX, fY, fZ,
				fRotX, fRotY, fRotZ
				);

				mysql_tquery( mysql_connect_ID, str_big, "CreateFurniture", "ii", i, id );
			}
			else if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"fursel") == 2 )
			{
                mysql_format:str_small( "\
				UPDATE `" #DB_FURNITURE "` SET \
					`X` = '%f', `Y` = '%f', `Z` = '%f', `RX` = '%f', `RY` = '%f', `RZ` = '%f' \
				WHERE \
					`ID` = '%d'",
				fX, fY, fZ,
				fRotX, fRotY, fRotZ,
				fInfo[ i ][ fID ][ id ]
				);

				mysql_tquery( mysql_connect_ID, str_small, "", "" );
			}

			DeletePVar( playerid, "fursel" );

		    return 1;
		}

	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"editcarattach")==1) // редактирование аттача
		{
			new
				i = GetPVarInt( playerid, "editattachcar"),
				car = GetPVarInt( playerid, "attachcar"),
				Float:ofx, Float:ofy, Float:ofz, Float:ofaz,
   				Float:finalx, Float:finaly,
   				Float:px, Float:py, Float:pz, Float:roz;

			GetVehiclePos(cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], px, py, pz);
        	GetVehicleZAngle(cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], roz);

         	ofx = fX-px;
          	ofy = fY-py;
           	ofz = fZ-pz;
            ofaz = fRotZ-roz;

            finalx = ofx*floatcos(roz, degrees)+ofy*floatsin(roz, degrees);
            finaly = -ofx*floatsin(roz, degrees)+ofy*floatcos(roz, degrees);

            AttachDynamicObjectToVehicle(cInfo[ car ][ cAttachID ][ i ], cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], finalx, finaly, ofz, fRotX, fRotY, ofaz);

            cInfo[ car ][ cObjectX ][ i ] = finalx,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectY ][ i ] = finaly,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectZ ][ i ] = ofz,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfX ][ i ] = fRotX,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfY ][ i ] = fRotY,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfZ ][ i ] = ofaz;

			SCM(playerid,0xB2EC5DFF,"Вы успешно отредактировали крепление предмета");
			DeletePVar(playerid,"editcarattach");

			SaveCarAttach( car );

			cmd::attachcar(playerid);

			return 1;
		}

		if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"editcarattach")==2) // установка аттача
		{
			new
				i = GetPVarInt( playerid, "editattachcar"),
				car = GetPVarInt( playerid, "attachcar"),
				d,
				Float:ofx, Float:ofy, Float:ofz, Float:ofaz,
   				Float:finalx, Float:finaly,
   				Float:px, Float:py, Float:pz, Float:roz;

      		GetVehiclePos(cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], px, py, pz);
        	GetVehicleZAngle(cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], roz);

         	ofx = fX-px;
          	ofy = fY-py;
           	ofz = fZ-pz;
            ofaz = fRotZ-roz;

            finalx = ofx*floatcos(roz, degrees)+ofy*floatsin(roz, degrees);
            finaly = -ofx*floatsin(roz, degrees)+ofy*floatcos(roz, degrees);

            AttachDynamicObjectToVehicle(cInfo[ car ][ cAttachID ][ i ], cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], finalx, finaly, ofz, fRotX, fRotY, ofaz);

            cInfo[ car ][ cObjectX ][ i ] = finalx,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectY ][ i ] = finaly,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectZ ][ i ] = ofz,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfX ][ i ] = fRotX,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfY ][ i ] = fRotY,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfZ ][ i ] = ofaz;

			for( new j; j != 10; j++ )
			{
				if(_invPlayer[playerid][invSlot][j] == cInfo[ car ][ cObjectInv ][ i ]) d = j;
			}

			SendMes(playerid,-1,"Вы успешно прикрепили " #C_GRAY "%s " #C_WHITE "на слот %d", GetObjName( cInfo[ car ][ cAttachObject ][ i ] ), i + 1 );

			_invPlayer[playerid][invSlotKol][d] -= 1;
			if( _invPlayer[playerid][invSlotKol][d] <= 0 ) _invPlayer[playerid][invSlot][d] = 0;

			SaveInventory(playerid);

			DeletePVar(playerid,"editcarattach");

			SaveCarAttach( car );

			cmd::attachcar(playerid);

			return 1;
		}
	}
	else if( response == EDIT_RESPONSE_CANCEL )
    {
    	if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"fursel") == 1 )
		{
			DestroyDynamicObjected( fInfo[ GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid") ][ fObjectid ][ GetPVarInt( playerid, "furslot" ) ]);
		    fInfo[ GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid") ][ fObjectid ][ GetPVarInt( playerid, "furslot" ) ] = EOS;
		    fInfo[ GetPVarInt(playerid,"nmenuid") ][ fObject ][ GetPVarInt( playerid, "furslot" ) ] = EOS;
		    DeletePVar( playerid, "fursel" );
		    return 1;
		}

		if( GetPVarInt(playerid,"fursel") == 2 )
		{
			SPD( playerid, dFurniture, list, " ","" #C_GRAY "•{FFFFFF} Отредактировать мебель\n" #C_GRAY "•{FFFFFF} Установить мебель","Ок","Назад");
		    DeletePVar( playerid, "fursel" );
		    return 1;
		}

        if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"editcarattach") == 1)
		{
		    DeletePVar(playerid,"editcarattach");
		    SCM(playerid, -1, "Вы отменили редактирование предмета!");

		    new
				i = GetPVarInt( playerid, "editattachcar"),
				car = GetPVarInt( playerid, "attachcar"),
				Float:ofx, Float:ofy, Float:ofz, Float:ofaz,
   				Float:finalx, Float:finaly,
   				Float:px, Float:py, Float:pz, Float:roz;

			GetVehiclePos(cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], px, py, pz);
        	GetVehicleZAngle(cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], roz);

         	ofx = fX-px;
          	ofy = fY-py;
           	ofz = fZ-pz;
            ofaz = fRotZ-roz;

            finalx = ofx*floatcos(roz, degrees)+ofy*floatsin(roz, degrees);
            finaly = -ofx*floatsin(roz, degrees)+ofy*floatcos(roz, degrees);

            AttachDynamicObjectToVehicle(cInfo[ car ][ cAttachID ][ i ], cInfo[ car ][ cCar ], finalx, finaly, ofz, fRotX, fRotY, ofaz);

            cInfo[ car ][ cObjectX ][ i ] = finalx,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectY ][ i ] = finaly,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectZ ][ i ] = ofz,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfX ][ i ] = fRotX,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfY ][ i ] = fRotY,
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectfZ ][ i ] = ofaz;

			SaveCarAttach( car );

		    return 1;
		}
		else if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"editcarattach") == 2)
		{
			new
				i = GetPVarInt( playerid, "editattachcar"),
				car = GetPVarInt( playerid, "attachcar");

			SCM(playerid, -1, "Вы отменили установку предмета!");
			cInfo[ car ][ cAttachID ][ i ] = 0;
			cInfo[ car ][ cObjectInv ][ i ] = 0;
			cInfo[ car ][ cAttachObject ][ i ] = 0;
		}
		DeletePVar(playerid,"editcarattach");

		DeletePVar(playerid,"editobject");

		DeletePVar(playerid,"editfrakobject");
		DeletePVar(playerid,"selectSlot");

		DestroyDynamicObjected(objectid);
		SCM(playerid,0xCD4B47FF,"Вы отменили действие");

		Streamer_UpdateEx(playerid, fX, fY, fZ );
    }
    else if( response == EDIT_RESPONSE_UPDATE )
    {
    	CheckEditObject(playerid, fX, fY, fZ );
    }
    Streamer_Update(playerid);
	return 1;
}

public OnVehicleDamageStatusUpdate(vehicleid, playerid)
{
	for( new i; i != LoadAllCar; i++ )
	{
	    if(vehicleid == cInfo[i][cCar])
	    {
			if( cInfo[i][cEngine] == 1 )
			{
				SetVehicleHealth(cInfo[i][cCar], 450.0);
				cInfo[i][cHealth] = 450.0;

				mysql_format:str_big( "UPDATE `" #DB_CARS "` SET `health` = '%f', `damage` = '%d|%d|%d|%d', `engine` = '%d' WHERE `ID` = '%d'",
				cInfo[i][cHealth],
				cInfo[i][cDamage][0],
				cInfo[i][cDamage][1],
				cInfo[i][cDamage][2],
				cInfo[i][cDamage][3],
				cInfo[i][cEngine],
				cInfo[i][cID]
				);

				mysql_tquery( mysql_connect_ID, str_big, "", "" );

				break;
			}
	        new engine,lights,alarm,doors,bonnet,boot,objective;
			GetVehicleParamsEx(cInfo[i][cCar],engine,lights,alarm,doors,bonnet,boot,objective);

	        GetVehicleHealth(cInfo[i][cCar], cInfo[i][cHealth]);
	        GetVehicleDamageStatus(cInfo[i][cCar], cInfo[i][cDamage][0], cInfo[i][cDamage][1], cInfo[i][cDamage][2], cInfo[i][cDamage][3]);

	        if(cInfo[i][cHealth] <= 450.0)
		    {
				if( cInfo[i][cHealth] == 0 )
				{
					cInfo[i][cEngine] = 0;
					cInfo[i][cHealth] = 1000.0;
					SetVehicleHealth( cInfo[i][cCar], 1000.0 );
					break;
				}

		    	cInfo[i][cEngine] = 1;
		        SetVehicleHealth(cInfo[i][cCar], 450.0);
				if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) == cInfo[i][cCar]) SCM(playerid, -1, "" #C_ORANGE "Двигатель автомобиля заглох!");
				SetVehicleParamsEx(cInfo[i][cCar],0,lights,alarm,doors,bonnet,boot,objective);

				mysql_format:str_big( "UPDATE `" #DB_CARS "` SET `health` = '%f', `damage` = '%d|%d|%d|%d', `engine` = '%d' WHERE `ID` = '%d'",
				cInfo[i][cHealth],
				cInfo[i][cDamage][0],
				cInfo[i][cDamage][1],
				cInfo[i][cDamage][2],
				cInfo[i][cDamage][3],
				cInfo[i][cEngine],
				cInfo[i][cID]
				);

				mysql_tquery( mysql_connect_ID, str_big, "", "" );

				break;
		    }

	        break;
	    }
	}
    return 1;
}

public OnPlayerEnterCheckpoint(playerid)
{

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"check1")==1)

	}

	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"check12")==1)
	{

		DisablePlayerCheckpoint(playerid);

				format:str_small("{FFCF0B}Остановка \"%s\". {ffffff}Время ожидания: %d секунд", mWay12[GetPVarInt(playerid,"bcheck")][mHname], mWay12[GetPVarInt(playerid,"bcheck")][mHfreeze]-1);

			}
			if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"bcheck")==15) return SetPVarInt(playerid,"bmoney",GetPVarInt(playerid,"bmoney")+1250), SPD(playerid,dJob+5,list,"" #C_GRAY "Что дальше ?","" #C_GRAY "1.{ffffff} Еду еще один круг по этому маршруту\n" #C_GRAY "2.{ffffff} Меняю номер маршрута\n" #C_GRAY "3.{ffffff} Заканчиваю свою смену","Ок","");
			SetPVarInt(playerid,"bcheck",GetPVarInt(playerid,"bcheck")+1);

		}

	    new neset = random(5); new zarplata[9], perenos[9]; if(neset == 0) SetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata",GetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata")+1200); if(neset == 1) SetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata",GetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata")+1500); if(neset == 2) SetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata",GetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata")+2000); if(neset == 3) SetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata",GetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata")+2501); if(neset == 4) SetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata",GetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata")+2500);
		f(zarplata),"%d",GetPVarInt(playerid,"zarplata"));

	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerEnterRaceCheckpoint(playerid)
{
    // Автошкола
    if(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) >= acar_b[0] && GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) <= acar_b[2] || GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) >= acar_a[0] && GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) <= acar_a[2] || GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) == acar_c[0] || GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid) == acar_d[0] )
    {
		new Float:x,Float:y,Float:z; GetVehicleVelocity(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid),x,y,z);
	    if(floatround(floatsqroot(((x*x)+(y*y))+(z*z))*101.666667)>65) SendClientMessage(playerid,-1,"[Инструктор]: " #C_GRAY "Вы превысили допустимую скорость (60 км/ч). Будьте внимательнее!"), SetPVarInt(playerid,"oshibka",GetPVarInt(playerid,"oshibka")+1);

		if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 1) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK2,B_CHECK3,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 2);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 2) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK3,B_CHECK4,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 3);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 3) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK4,B_CHECK5,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 4);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 4) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK5,B_CHECK6,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 5);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 5) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK6,B_CHECK7,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 6);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 6) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK7,B_CHECK8,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 7);

	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 9) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK10,B_CHECK11,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 10);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 10) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK11,B_CHECK12,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 11);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 11) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK12,B_CHECK13,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 12);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 12) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK13,B_CHECK14,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 13);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 13) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK14,B_CHECK15,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 14);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 14) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK15,B_CHECK16,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 15);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 15) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK16,B_CHECK17,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 16);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 16) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK17,B_CHECK18,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 17);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 17) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK18,B_CHECK19,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 18);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 18) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK19,B_CHECK20,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 19);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 19) return SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,B_CHECK20,B_CHECK21,3.5),SetPVarInt(playerid, "LESSON", 20);
	    if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"LESSON") == 20)
	    {
		    new Float:heal;
		    GetVehicleHealth(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid),heal);
		    if(heal < 900.0 || GetPVarInt(playerid,"remen") == 0 && PlayerInCAR(playerid))
			{
				SendClientMessage(playerid,-1,"{FFFFFF}[Инструктор]" #C_GRAY "Вы не сдали практический экзамен!");
				DeletePVar(playerid,"LESSON"); DeletePVar(playerid,"ekzamen"); DeletePVar(playerid,"practicexam");

				cmd::ame(playerid,"Отстегнул ремень безопасности"), SetPVarInt(playerid,"remen",0);
			}
		    if(IsTrailerAttachedToVehicle(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid))) { SetVehicleToRespawn(GetVehicleTrailer(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid))); DetachTrailerFromVehicle(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid)); }
		    RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid);
			SetVehicleToRespawn(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid));
			DisablePlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid);
			return 1;
		}

        if(buscheck[playerid] == 3) return buscheck[playerid]++, SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,250.4372,860.2670,12.6138,338.4313,1610.1451,12.6136,5.0);
        if(buscheck[playerid] == 4) return buscheck[playerid]++, SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,338.4313,1610.1451,12.6136,111.1495,1308.9055,12.6155,5.0);
        if(buscheck[playerid] == 5) return buscheck[playerid]++, SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,111.1495,1308.9055,12.6155,20.4193,917.0645,12.6165,5.0);
        if(buscheck[playerid] == 6) return buscheck[playerid]++, SetPlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid,0,20.4193,917.0645,12.6165,-54.0332,909.5702,12.6164,5.0);
        if(buscheck[playerid] == 7)
        {
        new string[256];
        format(string, sizeof(string), "Вы завершили свой рейс, и получили %d рублей.", buscheck[playerid] * 50);
        SCM(playerid, COLOR_ORANGE, string);
        SetVehicleToRespawn(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid));
        GiveMoney(playerid, buscheck[playerid] * 50);
        if(buscheck[playerid] != 0) return buscheck[playerid] = 0;
        return 1;
        }
	}
	//else SCM(playerid,-1,"Вы должны находиться за рулем учебного автомобиля");
	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerSelectedMenuRow(playerid, row)
{
	if(pInfo[playerid][pAdmin] < 1) return 1;
    new Menu:Current = GetPlayerMenu(playerid);

	if(Current == spec)
	{
	    new
			specid,
	        specid2 = GetPVarInt( playerid, "spectable" ),
			maxid = GetPlayersID(1),
			minid = GetPlayersID(0);

	    switch(row)
	    {
	        case 0: // NEXT
	        {
				for(new id = specid2; id != maxid+1; id ++)
				{
					if( id > maxid )
					{
						specid = minid;
	        			break;
					}

    				if( IsPlayerConnected(id) && specid2 != id && GetPVarInt(id,"spec") != 1 && GetPVarInt(id,"gLogged") == 1 )
    				{
	        			specid = id;
	        			break;
    				}
				}

				if( specid == specid2 )
				{
					return SCM(playerid, -1, "На сервере нет больше игроков!"), Specon(playerid, specid);
				}

				DeletePVar(playerid,"spec"), HideMenuForPlayer(spec,playerid),
				DeletePVar(playerid,"spectable");

				Specon(playerid, specid);

			    return 1;
	        }

	        case 1: // BACK
	        {
				for(new id = specid2; id != maxid; id-- )
				{
				    if( id < minid )
				    {
				    	specid = maxid;
	        			break;
				    }

        			if( IsPlayerConnected(id) && specid2 != id && GetPVarInt(id,"spec") != 1 && GetPVarInt(id,"gLogged") == 1 )
    				{
	        			specid = id;
	        			break;
    				}
				}

                if( specid == specid2 )
				{
					return SCM(playerid, -1, "На сервере нет больше игроков!"), Specon(playerid, specid);
				}

				DeletePVar(playerid,"spec"), HideMenuForPlayer(spec,playerid),
				DeletePVar(playerid,"spectable");

				Specon(playerid, specid);

			    return 1;
	        }

	        case 2: // stats
	        {
	            if(!IsPlayerConnected(specid2) || ( specid2 == playerid) || GetPVarInt(specid2,"spec") == 1) return SCM(playerid,-1,"ID игрока не найдено!");
	            statsa(specid2,playerid);
	        }

	        case 3: // inv
	        {
	            if(!IsPlayerConnected(specid2) || ( specid2 == playerid) || GetPVarInt(specid2,"spec") == 1) return SCM(playerid,-1,"ID игрока не найдено!");
	            ShowInva(specid2,playerid);

	        }

	        case 4: // slap
	        {
             	if(!IsPlayerConnected(specid2) || ( specid2 == playerid) || GetPVarInt(specid2,"spec") == 1) return SCM(playerid,-1,"ID игрока не найдено!");
	            format:str_least("%d", GetPVarInt(playerid,"spectable") );
				cmd::slap(playerid, str_least);
	        }

	        case 5: // exit
	        {
	        	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"spec") == 1)
			    {
					return Specoff(playerid);
				}
	        }
	    }
	    return 1;
	}
	return 1;
}

public OnPlayerKeyStateChange(playerid, newkeys, oldkeys)
{
	if(GetPVarInt(playerid, "gLogged") != 1) return 1;

	if(!IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid))
	{
		if(newkeys & KEY_SPRINT && newkeys & KEY_JUMP)
		{
			if(pInfo[playerid][pAdmin] < 0 )
			{
				SendClientMessage(playerid, COLOR_YELLOW, "Нельзя совмещать бег и прыжок!");
				ClearAnimations(playerid);
			    return ApplyAnimation(playerid,"FAT","IDLE_tired",4.0,0,0,0,0,0);
			}
		}
	}
//КУРЬЕР

// 145.7112, 672.8157, 12.7614 - это координаты твоего офиса
    if(newkeys & KEY_SECONDARY_ATTACK) // Клавиша ALT
    {
        if(IsPlayerInRangeOfPoint(playerid, 3.0, 145.7112, 672.8157, 12.7614))
        {
            ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, 750, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, "Офис курьера", "1. Устроиться на работу\n2. Уволиться", "Выбрать", "Назад");
        }
    }

//============================[ ПОВОРОТНИКИ ]========================
	if(newkeys & KEY_LOOK_LEFT && IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid))
	{
		new vid = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);

		if(_:cInfo[vid][vRightBlink] != 0)
		{
			cInfo[vid][vRightBlink] = 0;
			SetVehicleTurnlights(vid, 0);
		}
		else
		{
			cInfo[vid][vRightBlink] = 1;
			SetVehicleTurnlights(vid, 2);
		}
	}
	if(newkeys & KEY_LOOK_RIGHT && IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid))
	{
		new vid = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);

		if(_:cInfo[vid][vLeftBlink] != 0)
		{
			cInfo[vid][vLeftBlink] = 0;
			SetVehicleTurnlights(vid, 0);
		}
		else
		{
			cInfo[vid][vLeftBlink] = 1;
			SetVehicleTurnlights(vid, 1);
		}
	}
//=====================================================================
   	if(newkeys & KEY_SPRINT && newkeys & KEY_JUMP && GetPlayerState(playerid) != 2)
	{
	    SendClientMessage(playerid, COLOR_LIGHT_RED, "[СИСТЕМА] На нашем проекте запрещен Banny Hop.");
	    ClearAnimations(playerid);
	  	ApplyAnimation(playerid,"FAT","IDLE_tired",4.0,0,0,0,0,0);
	}
    if(newkeys & KEY_YES)
    {
    	if(GetPVarInt(playerid,"AntiFlood") > gettime()) return SCM(playerid, COLOR_WHITE, "Предупреждение: " #C_GRAY "не флудите !");
        if(!IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid))
		{
	    	new Float:posx, Float:posy, Float:posz;
      		GetPlayerPos(playerid,posx, Float:posy, Float:posz);

			for(new cars; cars != MAX_VEHICLES; cars++)
 			{
 				if(IsVelo(cars)) continue;
 				if(IsBike(cars)) continue;
				if(cars != INVALID_VEHICLE_ID)
				{
 					if(GetVehicleModel(cars) < 400 || GetVehicleModel(cars) > 611) continue;
				 	new Float:oldposx, Float:oldposy, Float:oldposz;
					GetVehiclePos(cars, oldposx, oldposy, oldposz);
					new Float: tempposx = (oldposx -posx);
					new Float: tempposy = (oldposy -posy);
					new Float: tempposz = (oldposz -posz);
					if (((tempposx < 3.0) && (tempposx > -3.0)) && ((tempposy < 3.0) && (tempposy > -3.0)) && ((tempposz < 3.0) && (tempposz > -3.0)))
					{
	 					new engine,lights,alarm,doors,bonnet,boot,objective;
	 					GetVehicleParamsEx(cars,engine,lights,alarm,doors,bonnet,boot,objective);

	 					GetBonnetVehiclePos(cars, oldposx, oldposy, oldposz); // багажник
	 					if(IsPlayerInRangeOfPoint(playerid,1.8, oldposx, oldposy, oldposz))
	 					{
	 						if(BonnetCar[cars] == 0)
					        {
					            BonnetCar[cars] = 1;

					           	for( new i; i != LoadAllCar; i++ ) // меню багажника
								{
								    if(cInfo[i][cCar] == cars)
								    {

								        if( cInfo[i][cLockb] == 0 )
								        {
								            SCM(playerid,-1,"Багажник автомобиля - закрыт!");
	 						    			return 1;
								        }

								    	SetPVarInt(playerid,"invcarmenu",i);
								    	SPD(playerid,dCar+16,list,"" #C_GRAY "Багажник","" #C_GRAY "1. {ffffff}Заглянуть в багажник\n" #C_GRAY "2. {ffffff}Положить предмет в багажник\n" #C_GRAY "3. {ffffff}Положить несколько предметов в багажник\n" #C_GRAY "4. {ffffff}Закрыть багажник","Ок","Закрыть");
								    	break;
								    }
								}

								SetVehicleParamsEx(cars,engine,lights,alarm,doors,bonnet,1,objective);

								SetPlayerChatBubble(playerid,"открыл багажник автомобиля",0xAF5DD2FF,30.0,10000);

					            return SetPVarInt(playerid,"AntiFlood",gettime() + 1);
					        }
					        else
					        {
					            BonnetCar[cars] = 0;
					            SetVehicleParamsEx(cars,engine,lights,alarm,doors,bonnet,0,objective);
					            SetPlayerChatBubble(playerid,"закрыл багажник автомобиля",0xAF5DD2FF,30.0,10000);
					            return SetPVarInt(playerid,"AntiFlood",gettime() + 1);
					        }
	 					}

	 					GetHoodVehiclePos(cars, oldposx, oldposy, oldposz); // капот

					            return SetPVarInt(playerid,"AntiFlood",gettime() + 1);

public OnPlayerUpdate(playerid)
{
    if(GetPlayerMoney(playerid) != pInfo[playerid][pMoney]) ResetPlayerMoney(playerid), GivePlayerMoney(playerid,pInfo[playerid][pMoney]);
	DeletePVar(playerid,"afk");
	ac_CheckWeapon(playerid);
	if(pInfo[playerid][pAdmin]==0 && IsValidDynamic3DTextLabel(adutytxd[playerid])) DestroyDynamic3DTextLabel(adutytxd[playerid]);
	if(AcceptSpec[playerid]==0 && pInfo[playerid][pAntiSpec]!=1) SCM(playerid,COLOR_RED,"[ЗАПРЕТЫ] {ffffff}Вам запрещено испльзовать AntiSpec"),AcceptSpec[playerid]=1;
	new weapon, ammo;

	if (GetPlayerWeaponData(playerid, 4, weapon, ammo) && weapon == 29)
	{
		if (GetPlayerWeapon(playerid) != weapon) {
			//SetPlayerAttachedObject(playerid, 4, 353, 1, 0.239999, 0.197000, -0.179999, -2.500002, 46.200088, 179.599822);
		}
		else if (IsPlayerAttachedObjectSlotUsed(playerid, 4)) {
			RemovePlayerAttachedObject(playerid, 4);
		}
	}
	if (gTabVisible[playerid])
    {
        if (GetPlayerState(playerid) == PLAYER_STATE_ONFOOT)
        {
            // можно оставить пустым
        }
    }
    if(IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid))
	{
		new Float:vSpeed;
		new vehicleid = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);

		// Получаем скорость (стандартная формула)
		new Float:vx, Float:vy, Float:vz;
		GetVehicleVelocity(vehicleid, vx, vy, vz);
		vSpeed = floatsqroot(vx*vx + vy*vy + vz*vz) * 180.0; // 180.0 для КМ/Ч

		// 1. Показываем спидометр (если еще не показан)
		cef_emit_event(playerid, "interface:show", "car");

		// 2. Обновляем цифры скорости (id="text_speed")
		new speed_str[64];
		format(speed_str, sizeof(speed_str), "document.getElementById('text_speed').innerText = '%d';", floatround(vSpeed));
		cef_emit_event(playerid, speed_str);

		// 3. Обновляем круговую шкалу (вызов функции из вашего HTML)
		new circle_str[64];
		format(circle_str, sizeof(circle_str), "setSpeedCircle(%d);", floatround(vSpeed));
		cef_emit_event(playerid, circle_str);
	}
	else
	{
		// Если игрок вышел из машины — скрываем спидометр
		cef_emit_event(playerid, "interface:hide", "car");
	}

	if(GetPlayerWeapon(playerid) == 43 && GetPlayerCameraMode(playerid) == 46)
    {
        for (new i; i < 1000; i++) if (IsVehicleStreamedIn(i, playerid))
        {
            new Float:x, Float:y, Float:z;
            new Float:vX, Float:vY, Float:vZ;

            GetVehiclePos(i, x, y, z);
            GetVehicleVelocity(i, vX, vY, vZ);

            if (IsPlayerInRangeOfPoint(playerid, 30.0, x, y, z))
            {
                new str[32];
                new Float:speed = floatmul(floatsqroot((vX * vX) + (vY * vY) + (vZ * vZ)), 100.0);
                new Float: Distance = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerid, x, y, z);
                new model = GetVehicleModel(i);
                format(str, sizeof(str), "% 0.1f kЇ/¤", speed);
                //PlayerTextDrawSetString(playerid, speedo5[playerid], str);

                format(str, sizeof(str), "%0.1f Ї", Distance);
                //PlayerTextDrawSetString(playerid, speedo4[playerid], str);

public OnPlayerStreamIn(playerid, forplayerid)
{
    // playerid - это тот, кто вошел в зону стрима (видит игрока)
    // forplayerid - это тот, кого прогрузили (игрок, который находится в зоне видимости)



    // Если игрок, которого прогрузили (forplayerid), находится в маске,
    // мы скрываем его ник от того, кто его видит (playerid)
    if(GetPVarInt(forplayerid, "mask") != 0)
    {
        ShowPlayerNameTagForPlayer(playerid, forplayerid, 0);
    }
 	if(AdminDuty[forplayerid]!=false) ShowPlayerNameTagForPlayer(playerid,forplayerid,0);
    return 1;
}

{
	return 1;
}

public OnVehicleStreamIn(vehicleid, forplayerid)
{
    // Безопасный поиск индекса
    new idx = FindCarID(vehicleid);

    // 1. Синхронизация маячков (без лишнего кода)
    if(VehSiren[vehicleid][vSiren])
    {
        new BitStream:bsn = BS_New();
        BS_WriteValue(bsn, PR_UINT8, 220, PR_UINT16, vehicleid);
        PR_SendPacket(bsn, forplayerid);
        BS_Delete(bsn);
    }

    // 2. Синхронизация состояния
    if(VehSiren[vehicleid][vSirenState] > 0)
    {
        new BitStream:bsn = BS_New();
        BS_WriteValue(bsn, PR_UINT8, 221, PR_UINT16, vehicleid, PR_UINT8, VehSiren[vehicleid][vSirenState]);
        PR_SendPacket(bsn, forplayerid);
        BS_Delete(bsn);
    }

    // 3. Тонировка (БЕЗ sscanf в событии стриминга)
    if(idx != -1 && cInfo[idx][cToner_alpha] > 0)
    {
        // ВАЖНО: Храните r, g, b в cInfo как отдельные переменные,
        // чтобы не парсить строку через sscanf каждый раз
        SetWindowTinedForPlayer(forplayerid, vehicleid, cInfo[idx][cToner_glass_id],
            cInfo[idx][cToner_r], cInfo[idx][cToner_g], cInfo[idx][cToner_b],
            cInfo[idx][cToner_alpha]);
    }
    return 1;
}

public OnVehicleStreamOut(vehicleid, forplayerid)
{
	return 1;
}
